note: Defect ids sharing an architectural cause are one family; closure is by family. 'previous_fix' says whether the shipped fix removed the symptom (local) or the cause for every sibling (family-wide).

FAM-IDENTITY.name: Identity by recency or position
FAM-IDENTITY.cause: A control decision selects its evidence by chronological recency (`last`, newest, HEAD) or by position/spelling instead of by an exact identity (story epoch, candidate, baseline root, artifact digest, cohort directory).

FAM-OUTCOME.name: Outcome misclassification (absence / unrunnable read as pass or fail)
FAM-OUTCOME.cause: An absence, an environment failure or a non-verdict is mapped onto the two-valued pass/fail axis instead of a typed outcome (UNRUNNABLE, UNCONFIGURED, NOT_APPLICABLE, INFRA, HUMAN_REQUIRED).

FAM-PROSE.name: Prose parsed into control state
FAM-PROSE.cause: Free-form model or tool text is matched by substring/regex and the match creates control state, outranking or standing in for a structured source.

FAM-RETRY.name: Retry locality and budget accounting
FAM-RETRY.cause: A failure of one stage (reviewer, provider, tool, environment) is routed to a retry of another stage or charged to the wrong budget; the loop's only recovery path is 'open a developer session again'.

FAM-RECOVERY.name: Recovery and resume semantics
FAM-RECOVERY.cause: A resume or recovery action recomputes or changes evaluated state (baseline, worktree contents, candidate) without the evidence that depended on the previous state being invalidated or refreshed — or leaves the state unrecovered for the next attempt.

FAM-OWNERSHIP.name: Workspace ownership and generated files
FAM-OWNERSHIP.cause: Paths written by the harness, tools, generated client config or pre-existing dirt are attributed to the developer/story (or blamed on the wrong owner), so scope checks, freezes, diffs and merges act on files nobody authored.

FAM-TOOL.name: Tool declared but not available
FAM-TOOL.cause: A configured or inferred verification command is trusted to be runnable in the declared execution environment; its absence is read as a behavioural result.

FAM-PROCESS.name: Process lifecycle and liveness
FAM-PROCESS.cause: A parent process, lock or claim is treated as the whole: children survive their parent's death, a claim survives its process, cleanup races a writer.

FAM-SCHEDULER.name: Scheduler uses declared scope, not effective scope
FAM-SCHEDULER.cause: Two rules for one truth: the scheduler partitions waves by declared write_scope while the guard grants additional shared paths.

FAM-APPROVAL.name: Approval and pre-registration binding
FAM-APPROVAL.cause: A human decision (approval, frozen rule, acceptance scope) is bound to memory, mtime or an implicit default rather than to an exact artifact digest or an explicit declaration.

FAM-RELEASE.name: Release and closure identity
FAM-RELEASE.cause: Product identity is conflated with repository HEAD, platform-dependent spellings or a second implementation of the same digest, so recording evidence or moving platforms changes 'what was released'.

FAM-BENCH.name: Benchmark integrity
FAM-BENCH.cause: Bench artifacts, cohorts and stop rules leak across directories/experiments or depend on the operator; infrastructure failures are written as results.

FAM-JUDGE.name: Model output as control authority
FAM-JUDGE.cause: A model verdict is the sole basis of a blocking decision or a plan conflict, or model failure is indistinguishable from framework misclassification.
